queries.name: Agent Ready
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.State] <> 'Closed' AND [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'agent-ready' AND [System.Tags] NOT CONTAINS 'agent-running' ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC

queries.name: Agent Running
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.State] <> 'Closed' AND [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'agent-running' ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC

queries.name: Demo Critical Not Verified
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.State] <> 'Closed' AND [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'demo-critical' AND [System.Tags] NOT CONTAINS 'verified' ORDER BY [Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Priority]

queries.name: ML Experiments in Eval Gate
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags],[System.BoardColumn] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'ml-experiment' AND [System.BoardColumn] = 'Eval Gate' ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC

queries.name: No Fake Data Violations
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'no-fake-data' AND ([System.Tags] CONTAINS 'source-missing' OR [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'stale-input' OR [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'agent-blocked') ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC

queries.name: Human Approval Required
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.State] <> 'Closed' AND [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'human-approval' ORDER BY [Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Priority]

queries.name: PR Open
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.State] <> 'Closed' AND [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'pr-open' ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC

queries.name: Evidence Missing
queries.wiql: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.Tags] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'Novendor\RS-Analytics' AND [System.State] = 'Resolved' AND [System.Tags] NOT CONTAINS 'verified' ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC

deliveryPlan.name: RS - Winston MLOps Delivery Plan
deliveryPlan.note: Azure DevOps plan names reject slash characters, so the requested slash is represented by a hyphen.

deferred.testPlans: Requires a dedicated Azure DevOps PAT and confirmed Test Plans license.
deferred.serviceHook: Enable only after the Agent Ready polling workflow is stable.
deferred.githubEnvironments: Configure protected deployment approvals in GitHub, not Azure Pipelines.
